gs_mapping: GS II - Health, Social Justice and Government Welfare Programmes

knowledge_points.title: Protection From Hospital Bills
knowledge_points.text: AB-PMJAY helps eligible families pay for major hospital treatment. Its cashless cover reduces the risk that serious illness will consume savings or push households into debt.

knowledge_points.title: Care Near Home
knowledge_points.text: Ayushman Arogya Mandirs bring primary healthcare closer to communities. People can seek everyday care locally instead of depending only on large hospitals for health services.

knowledge_points.title: Stronger Public Facilities
knowledge_points.text: PM-ABHIM supports hospitals, critical care and disease monitoring. Better health infrastructure strengthens the system that people depend on when serious illness or public health threats arise.

knowledge_points.title: Connected Health Records
knowledge_points.text: The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission helps patients securely share health records with their consent. Doctors at different facilities can access relevant information and provide more coordinated care.

knowledge_points.title: Care Across State Borders
knowledge_points.text: AB-PMJAY allows eligible patients to receive cashless treatment at participating hospitals outside their home State. This helps migrant families and people seeking specialised care elsewhere.

quick_facts.text: AB-PMJAY provides Rs 5 lakh per eligible family annually for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation. Unlike care centres, it covers hospital treatment; over 13 crore admissions were authorised.
Over 1.8 lakh Ayushman Arogya Mandirs offer nearby primary care. PM-ABHIM, launched in 2021 with Rs 64,180 crore, strengthens critical care and disease surveillance infrastructure.
The National Health Authority sets standards and IT platforms, while State Health Agencies manage hospital empanelment and claims. ABHA enables consent-based health record sharing.
Ayushman Vay Vandana covers people aged 70 and above regardless of income. Insurance coverage rose from 15% to over 50%; 97 crore ABHA numbers were reported.

key_takeaway: Ayushman Bharat links hospital insurance, nearby primary care, stronger public facilities and digital health records, while cross-State treatment access helps reduce financial hardship and improve healthcare access.
